facts.value: Resolves the supplied Turtle Item_GObj and reads Item.owner. If the owner is NULL, returns true without invoking either fighter helper. Otherwise passes the owner to ftGw_AttackAirN_ItemCheckTurtleRemove. A false result returns false without cleanup; a true result conditionally forwards the still-present owner to ftGw_AttackAirN_ItemTurtleSetFlag and returns true. That cleanup exits hitlag for tracked aerial articles and clears the fighter's Turtle reference, death2_cb and take_dmg_cb. The generic item animation dispatcher consumes the callback's true result as a request for common item destruction.
facts.rationale: Corrects the existing data-flow explanation's otherwise-false wording by explicitly preserving the ownerless true branch and separating owner bookkeeping from destruction by the callback consumer.

evidence.why: Shows ownerless completion, predicate forwarding, conditional notification and both return values.
Shows hitlag exit before clearing Turtle tracking and damage/death callbacks.
Shows that cleanup's hitlag-exit helper handles all tracked aerial articles.
Shows true animation-callback results entering common destruction.
